# Session API

<div class="doc-meta"><span class="doc-badge">Reference</span> Generated from <code>src/caffeine/script/api/session.json</code></div>

A key-value store that survives scene changes for as long as the game runs (score, settings, choices). Values are numbers, booleans or text. It is not saved to disk.

<!-- Generated by caffeine-website/scripts/generate-api-pages.py. Edit the engine JSON instead. -->

## Functions

### `caffeine.session.set`

`set(key, value)`

Stores a value.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | Name of the value. |
| `value` | number \| boolean \| string \| nil | The value to keep; nil removes the key. |

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.session.set("coins", 12)
```

### `caffeine.session.get`

`get(key) -> any`

Reads a value.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | Name of the value. |

**Returns:** `number | boolean | string | nil` — The stored value, or nil when the key does not exist.

**Example**

```lua
local coins = caffeine.session.get("coins") or 0
```

### `caffeine.session.has`

`has(key) -> boolean`

Tells whether a key exists.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | Name of the value. |

**Returns:** `boolean` — true when the key exists.

**Example**

```lua
if caffeine.session.has("checkpoint") then end
```

### `caffeine.session.remove`

`remove(key) -> boolean`

Deletes a key.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | Name of the value. |

**Returns:** `boolean` — true when the key existed.

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.session.remove("checkpoint")
```

### `caffeine.session.clear`

`clear()`

Deletes every key.

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.session.clear() -- new game
```
